title: Progressive Blur
concept: Brightwell Fusion: a compact-tokamak startup's power-offtake page where programme cards with glowing plasma tori slide under fixed top and bottom progressive-blur edges built from the skill's eight stepped backdrop-filter layers.
notes: Pure CSS, exact skill blur steps (0.5 → 64 px) and mask stops; top edge 12 %, bottom height tuned from 65 % to 42 % so the headline stays sharp. A placement switch (both / bottom / top / off) demonstrates each snippet; keyboard tabs swap the card set. Browsers without backdrop-filter get a plain paper fade. Reduced motion stops the plasma breathing and card rise.
